label: Marine and coastal outcomes
description: The Scottish Biodiversity Strategy to 2045 sets outcomes for marine and coastal environments, delivered through rolling Delivery Plans.

label: Delivery Plan: 30 by 30
description: Delivery Plan 2024-2030: ensure at least 30% of land and sea is protected and effectively managed to support nature in good health by 2030.

label: Delivery Plan: marine monitoring
description: Delivery Plan action to develop new approaches to marine biodiversity monitoring, covering state and pressures, aligned with the UK Marine Strategy.

label: Climate resilience (context)
description: Sea temperature is context for how marine outcomes respond to climate change.

label: Natural Environment (Scotland) Act 2026
description: Part 1 creates a legally binding framework for statutory nature restoration targets covering land and sea, with monitoring and reporting duties.

label: Marine (Scotland) Act 2010
description: Provides for Nature Conservation MPAs in Scottish territorial waters and for seal conservation, including protected haul-out sites (Part 6).

label: Conservation of Salmon Regulations 2016
description: Annual grading of 173 salmon stocks; poor status means mandatory catch and release for the season.

label: Special Protection Areas
description: Sites classified for birds. Many Scottish SPAs protect seabird colonies and their marine foraging areas.

label: Special Areas of Conservation
description: Sites designated for habitats and species, including harbour seal, grey seal, and Atlantic salmon.

label: B1 Marine bird abundance
description: OSPAR common indicator: trends in breeding and non-breeding abundance of marine birds.

label: B3 Breeding success/failure
description: OSPAR common indicator: breeding success of marine birds at colonies.

label: M3 Seal abundance and distribution
description: OSPAR common indicator: abundance and distribution of harbour and grey seals.

label: M5 Grey seal pup production
description: OSPAR common indicator: grey seal pup production at breeding colonies.

label: List of threatened/declining species
description: Atlantic salmon has been on the OSPAR List of Threatened and/or Declining Species since 2008 (Agreement 2008-6).

label: OSPAR MPA network
description: Scotland's MPAs contribute to OSPAR's network of marine protected areas in the North-East Atlantic.

label: QSR 2023 climate assessment
description: OSPAR's Quality Status Report 2023 includes a thematic assessment of climate change and ocean acidification.

label: D1 Biodiversity
description: Good Environmental Status descriptor for birds, mammals, fish, and habitats.

label: D4 Food webs
description: Seabirds are top predators, so their status reflects the state of marine food webs.

label: D6 Seafloor integrity
description: Protected areas contribute to seafloor integrity where activities that damage the seabed are managed.

label: D7 Hydrographical conditions
description: Temperature and other physical conditions, used here as context.

label: Target 3: 30x30
description: At least 30% of coastal and marine areas effectively conserved and managed by 2030.

label: Target 4: species recovery
description: Halt extinction and promote recovery of threatened species.

label: Target 5: sustainable use
description: Ensure harvesting and use of wild species is sustainable.

label: Target 8: climate impacts
description: Minimise the impacts of climate change on biodiversity.

label: Target 21: data and knowledge
description: Best available data, information, and knowledge accessible to decision makers.
